git_workflow: local commits only; no merge or push

environment.build_command: cargo build --release --locked -p netbaiot-server -p netbaiot-loadgen --bin netbaiot-server --bin netbaiot-loadgen
environment.sampling: ps cumulative CPU time; RSS/tasks/FD via existing tools

excluded_shared_checkout_comparison.timing_status: diagnostic only; concurrent same-host activity possible

measurement_boundaries.primary_rate: measurement PUBACK count /20sec; not doubled subscriber receipts
measurement_boundaries.sink_rate: full gateway SinkACK counter /actual generator elapsed; includes connect,warmup,cooldown
measurement_boundaries.cpu_event: cumulative process CPU before shutdown /full gateway EventAccepted
measurement_boundaries.rss: max sampled process RSS; excludes kernel socket memory
measurement_boundaries.percentiles: median of per-run histogram percentiles, never pooled or summed
measurement_boundaries.ACL_allocation: probe allocations+reallocations; varies with identity length
measurement_boundaries.RPC_event_ack_ms: consumer decoded-receive to ack-return; not device to ACK
measurement_boundaries.spool: opaque original+copy; trusted gateway exit plus MQTT snapshot evidence, not standalone decoder/replay proof
